[spoiler= Belorev International - Top Stories - 2 April, 2028]

[sub]Belorev International is funded partially or fully by the Republic of Ostarev.[/sub]

[b]Ostarevi National Guardsman Killed in Checkpoint Attack[/b]

The Ostarev Ministry of Defense announced on 2 April 2026, that a National Guardsman on deployment in Western Toqastan was killed following an attack on a checkpoint outside of the City of Kunda. The Ministry of Defense announced that the attack was orchestrated by members of the Ansar al-Toqa terrorist organization. The Ministry of Defense vowed to retaliate violently against Ansar al-Toqa. This is the seventh Ostarevi service member killed in Western Toqastan this year. 

[b]Ostarev Announcing Military Agreement with the United States of Lockheed[/b]

The United States of Lockheed and the Republic of Ostarev have come to an agreement where the USL will be able to jointly-operate in the Kashkent Naval Base alongside the Ostarevi Military. Reports from the Ministry of Defense also state that the USL will deploy air defense systems in the nation, the types of systems and the quantity are not known at this time. The USL has already announced that multiple warships and a detachment of soldiers are being sent to the Kashkent Naval Base. 

[/spoiler]

[b]The Republic of Toqastan Announces Military Agreement with Alaqar[/b]

The Republic of Toqastan will be welcoming the Armed Forces of Alaqar to Naval Air Station Al-Safra. The Armed Forces of Alaqar will be allowed to station Naval, Air, and Land assets in the base. The Republic of Toqastan says that this will lead to better relations between the two nations and will open a new door in the relations between the two nations. 

[/spoiler]
